applicant.name: Dr. Helena Fuchs
applicant.organisation: University Clinic for Cardiology, research group heart failure

purpose: Research on blood pressure control in heart failure, to compare care between hospitals and improve care pathways.
question: How many adults with heart failure have a systolic blood pressure value, and what is their mean systolic blood pressure, by hospital?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Heart failure = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I50.
Use the latest systolic blood pressure (LOINC 8480-6) per patient; patients without a value are left out.
Report per data_holder: adults with heart failure who have a systolic blood pressure value and their mean systolic blood pressure, one decimal.
